basics.name: Yanan Guo
basics.label: Structural Designer, Engineer, Researcher
basics.summary:
"For Design, Use Methods."

Structural engineer and computational designer, researcher with 15+ years spanning large-scale building structures and high-performance fibre-composite systems.

Ph.D. from the University of Stuttgart (defended successfully, 2026).

work.name: ITKE, University of Stuttgart, Germany
work.summary: FEM-based structural design of coreless filament-wound composites.
highlights: Award-winning built demonstrators (livMatS Pavilion, ITECH Research Pavilion, BamX! Pavilion, LightPRO Shell), focusing on structural engineering
Fast preliminary design method based on lamination parameters & multi-objective optimisation
Co-design workflows; ITECH teaching & thesis supervision

work.name: HJI International (structural consulting), Beijing, China
work.summary: Structural design and consultancy across the full design cycle for high-rise and complex long-span buildings.
highlights: High-rise mixed structures up to 221.5 m
Engineer-to-leader progression: modelling, calculation, project management & client coordination

work.name: Ruhr-Universität Bochum, Germany
work.summary: FEM-based research in steel construction at the Institute for Steel Structures (Stahlbau), Ruhr-Universität Bochum.

education.area: Ph.D. (defended successfully, 2026) — FEM-based structural design of coreless filament-wound composites
M.Sc. ITECH — Integrative Technologies & Architectural Design Research (International Course)

projects.name: AI-Assisted ML & Collaboration Methodology
projects.description: A contract-driven Rhino/Grasshopper–ANSYS chain turning scattered analysis routines into a verifiable workflow, combined with a physics-informed ML study curating ~12,000 datasets (64 features) from seven CFW projects. Handover notes, decision logs and verification matrices turned the work into a transferable human-AI collaboration method.

projects.name: IntCDC Building Fibre Component
projects.description: A research component applying the dissertation workflow end-to-end: lamination-parameter-based fibre layout prediction, uncertainty-aware FEM from measured data, and safety verification through meso-scale testing. Led fibre-network modelling, FEM implementation, data analysis and experimental verification, with team support.

projects.name: Yuehai Culture and Sports Center, Shenzhen
projects.description: Structural concept, preliminary design and code review for an interlocking cultural-sports complex. The spatial steel system combines cantilevers, transfer and reinforcement trusses with a braced core and large external supports; feasibility was cross-checked with a 1:20 physical structural model.

projects.name: ITECH Research Pavilion 2024
projects.description: First structural components combining natural-fibre composites with timber; tutor-group member responsible for structural modelling and calculation, supporting the construction process.

projects.name: livMatS Pavilion
projects.description: First building with a fully robotically wound flax-fibre load-bearing structure; FEM studies of global and component behaviour during the student research phase, later supporting final construction.

projects.name: Yanchang Petro Tower, Xi'an
projects.description: Structural consultancy and special steel design for a 221.5 m tower using a steel-plate shear-wall core, CFST columns and steel trusses.

projects.name: Yujing Center, Xiamen
projects.description: Full-cycle structural consultancy for a 210 m mixed tower and irregular podium, including wind-tunnel testing and multi-directional envelope design.

projects.name: Jining Cultural & Activity Center
projects.description: Structural concept, preliminary design and code review for a 100 m × 100 m public complex whose four functional zones share one structural language.

projects.name: Beach Park, Rizhao
projects.description: Parametric structural concept, 3D modelling, design and drawings for public buildings and a pedestrian bridge in a beach park.

projects.name: Hutong Courtyard Renovation (Bamboo-Steel), Beijing
projects.description: Bamboo-steel structural system for reinforcing and extending a traditional courtyard building, with 3D design, drawings and site coordination.

projects.name: Glass Staircase, School Media Room, Beijing
projects.description: Fully glazed spiral staircase realised through 3D modelling, material studies and direct connection detailing with the glass fabricator.
